dependency_order: Both CPU preparations first, then full regression; captures require their preparation; readouts require capture plus regression. CPU workers audit captures before fitting and audit parameters/metrics afterward.
eligibility: 8B short BF16 prefills fit 24GiB A30 or larger under scaled actual-token headroom; 34B needs >=72GiB and is eligible on H100/H200. H200 is included to use available capacity. Readout CPU jobs can use dev or normal,16threads/32G; dev has actual2h maximum and partial banks are resumable.
